title: Gem quota crash pattern: daily Gemini API limit produces crash logs as task output
body: Gem (Gemini CLI agent) periodically exhausts its daily Gemini API quota mid-task. When this occurs, the output comment contains a Gemini CLI crash log instead of implementation output. Peer reviewers must check the codebase — not just the comment — before approving. Multiple rejections with identical quota error signatures indicate an agent capacity problem requiring escalation to @miguel (see R11).
source_ref: lessons — 'Gem posts Gemini CLI crash logs as task output'; 'Gem hits daily Gemini API quota limits'; R09, R11
